summary.text: Tomi Strock is a Republican member of the Wyoming House of Representatives for District 6 who took office in January 2023 and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.

paragraphs.text: Tomi Strock was born in Douglas, Wyoming, and Ballotpedia lists her career experience as a rancher.
She assumed office on January 2, 2023, succeeding Aaron Clausen.

For 2025-2026 she was assigned to the House Education Committee, the House Agriculture, State and Public Lands and Water Resources Committee and the Select Water Committee, along with joint committees.
Strock defeated Jim Willox in the August 18, 2026 Republican primary, 52.4% to 47.6%, and no Democrat appeared on the primary ballot.
